record.model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ1_M, both shards (native, not the requant)
record.expert_cache: 2.3 GB, --pcie-frac 0.4 (T0: TPOT slope 10.7 -> 0.4 ms/GB), chunk 8192, one prefill buffer (the plan refuses the second below ~3 034 MiB free: decode reserve 700 MiB)
record.pcie_frac: 0.4 (T0: TPOT slope 0.4 ms/GB across 2.3 -> 1.85 GB, against 10.7 at 0.2; absolute TPOT 40.8 vs 41.7)
record.speculation: --mtp --mtp-draft-sampling greedy (automatic depth 2/3/4/6). Greedy drafting is worth -9.5% TPOT p50 and -22% p90 on the doc probe (acceptance 0.82 against 0.64), because at temperature 0 the target is greedy and a probabilistically drawn draft disagrees with it more often (M22 §13).
record.prefix_reuse: --prefix-cache-n 1 (one recurrent snapshot, ~111 MB), checkpoint at align_down(prompt, 32) since M16 item 1
record.prefill_chunking: --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-prefill-chunk-tokens 8192 are *ceilings*: the prefill path plans the step at warmup from the free VRAM it measures (chunk, and 1 or 2 layer buffers, from 160 MiB + 680 MiB per 1024 tokens of activations, Strata's formula, with an eighth of slack) and publishes it to the scheduler. On this card it lands on 1024 with one buffer
record.max_seqs: 4: the hybrid model reserves a ~112 MiB recurrent state per sequence slot, so the default 32 cost 3.5 GiB of VRAM for slots a one-request-at-a-time server never uses. At 4 the same card affords a 3 GB expert cache instead of 1 GB
record.drafter: MTP head's experts resident on the GPU in Q2_0 (moe::resident): 675 MiB, 2.25 bit/weight, same format/size strata uses; prefill 1696 rows 2.73 s -> 10.4 ms, draft forward 1.0-2.4 ms -> 0.55 ms
record.checkpoint_alignment: MISTRALRS_ALIGN_CHECKPOINTS=1 stops a verify step on the next paged block boundary, so the recurrent prefix checkpoint is taken at the end of every turn instead of only when a step happens to land on a boundary (measured 3/4 turns before). Costs nothing measurable: the dropped drafts are re-proposed next step and the continuation token is still sampled
record.status: Shipped candidate (M19). The borrow's race was a TOCTOU at the prefill/decode boundary: the gate was checked in upload_in_place, but the DMA was queued after the borrow could take the range, and the lookahead is asynchronous across that boundary. Fills now hold a lock from the check until their copies are queued, and the borrow holds it from setting the flag until its range is empty and every queued copy has landed. 60 stress iterations clean (was 10/12 failed), oracle gate byte-identical.
record.promotion: on by default since M20 §25: promote up to 1 staged expert per layer per step, only if it has been demanded >= 4 times (dynamic residency that follows decode). Measured neutral (-1.1 ms median, inside the baseline's 6 ms spread).
record.cold_start: --expert-profile strata/data/expert-profile-coder.bin: the cache starts with the profile's hot experts (strata's ranking), 0.14 s, no extra VRAM. Cold turn-1 TPOT 45.6 vs 48.1 and cold turn-2 34.0 vs 39.6 (M20 §29).
